content.json:
# ACS Email Delivery Dashboard
Monitors Azure Communication Services email delivery status using the `ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational` table.

> Use the parameters below to filter by time range and delivery status. Scroll down for **Sender Search** and **Recipient Lookup**.

parameters.name: DeliveryStatus
parameters.label: Delivery Status
parameters.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(DeliveryStatus)
| summarize by DeliveryStatus
| order by DeliveryStatus asc

content.query:
let LatestStatus =
    ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
    | where isnotempty(RecipientId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CorrelationId, RecipientId;
LatestStatus
| where "{DeliveryStatus}" == "value::all" or DeliveryStatus in ({DeliveryStatus})
| summarize
    TotalRecipients = count(),
    Delivered       = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Delivered"),
    OutForDelivery  = countif(DeliveryStatus == "OutForDelivery"),
    Bounced         = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Bounced"),
    Suppressed      = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Suppressed"),
    Failed          = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Failed"),
    HardBounces     = countif(tobool(IsHardBounce) == true)
    by SenderDomain, SenderUsername
| extend
    DeliveryRatePct    = round(100.0 * Delivered / TotalRecipients, 2),
    BounceRatePct      = round(100.0 * Bounced / TotalRecipients, 2),
    SuppressionRatePct = round(100.0 * Suppressed / TotalRecipients, 2),
    FailureRatePct     = round(100.0 * Failed / TotalRecipients, 2)
| project SenderDomain, SenderUsername, TotalRecipients, Delivered, DeliveryRatePct, Bounced, BounceRatePct, HardBounces, Suppressed, SuppressionRatePct, Failed, FailureRatePct, OutForDelivery
| order by TotalRecipients desc
content.title: Delivery Summary by Sender

content.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)

content.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| where "{DeliveryStatus}" == "value::all" or DeliveryStatus in ({DeliveryStatus})

content.json:
---
## 🔍 Sender Search
Filter by sender domain or username (partial match supported). Leave blank to show all senders.

content.query:
let domainFilter = '{SenderDomainFilter}';
let usernameFilter = '{SenderUsernameFilter}';
let LatestStatus =
    ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
    | where isnotempty(RecipientId)
    | where isempty(domainFilter) or SenderDomain contains domainFilter
    | where isempty(usernameFilter) or SenderUsername contains usernameFilter
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CorrelationId, RecipientId;
LatestStatus
| where "{DeliveryStatus}" == "value::all" or DeliveryStatus in ({DeliveryStatus})
| summarize
    TotalRecipients = count(),
    Delivered       = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Delivered"),
    Bounced         = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Bounced"),
    Suppressed      = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Suppressed"),
    Failed          = countif(DeliveryStatus == "Failed"),
    HardBounces     = countif(tobool(IsHardBounce) == true)
    by SenderDomain, SenderUsername
| extend
    DeliveryRatePct = round(100.0 * Delivered / TotalRecipients, 2),
    BounceRatePct   = round(100.0 * Bounced / TotalRecipients, 2),
    FailureRatePct  = round(100.0 * Failed / TotalRecipients, 2)
| order by TotalRecipients desc
content.title: Senders Matching Filter

content.query:
let domainFilter = '{SenderDomainFilter}';
let usernameFilter = '{SenderUsernameFilter}';
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| where isempty(domainFilter) or SenderDomain contains domainFilter
| where isempty(usernameFilter) or SenderUsername contains usernameFilter
| where "{DeliveryStatus}" == "value::all" or DeliveryStatus in ({DeliveryStatus})
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DeliveryStatus
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Delivery Trend for Filtered Senders

content.json:
---
## ✉️ Recipient / Message Lookup
Search by recipient email address or CorrelationId (partial match supported). Leave blank to show all.

content.query:
let recipientFilter = '{RecipientIdFilter}';
let correlationFilter = '{CorrelationIdFilter}';
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| where isempty(recipientFilter) or RecipientId contains recipientFilter
| where isempty(correlationFilter) or CorrelationId contains correlationFilter
| where "{DeliveryStatus}" == "value::all" or DeliveryStatus in ({DeliveryStatus})
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CorrelationId, RecipientId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    RecipientId,
    CorrelationId,
    DeliveryStatus,
    IsHardBounce,
    SenderDomain,
    SenderUsername
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: Message Delivery Lookup (latest status per message, max 500) — click a row to see its full status history below

content.query:
let selected = '{SelectedCorrelationId}';
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where OperationName == "DeliveryStatusUpdate"
| where isnotempty(selected) and CorrelationId == selected
| project TimeGenerated, DeliveryStatus, IsHardBounce, RecipientId, SenderDomain, SenderUsername, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Full Status History for Selected Message — every status event, chronological (click a row above)
